answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a bonded identity registry with slashing. Before an agent can vote or earn it locks a stake, and two identities traced to the same key or funding source forfeit every bond. Each fake account therefore needs its own bond and carries the risk of total loss once one link is found. Burying an honest echo by dumping shale into a lagoon costs per stone: scale buys noise only by paying linearly, so mass forgery never becomes cheap.
